passages.note: Assembly floor vote on concurrence in Senate amendments, final passage; Rivas voted Aye.
passages.tally_quote: Ayes Count 48 Noes Count 26 NVR Count 5

passages.provision_quote: This bill would, until January 1, 2030, prohibit an owner of residential real property from, over the course of any 12-month period, increasing the gross rental rate for a dwelling or unit more than 5% plus the percentage change in the cost of living, as defined, or 10%, whichever is lower, of the lowest gross rental rate charged for the immediately preceding 12 months, subject to specified conditions.
passages.note: Chaptered bill text/digest of AB 1482, the statewide rent-cap and just-cause provisions Rivas's vote enacted.

rows.reasoning: Rivas voted Aye on final passage of AB 1482 (2019-2020), a single-subject tenant-protection bill that caps annual statewide rent increases at 5% plus CPI or 10% (whichever is lower) and requires just cause for eviction, extending rent and eviction protection to units that previously had no state-level coverage, matching 'strengthen existing rent stabilization and extend coverage to more units.' The bill's exemptions for new construction, single-family owner-occupied units, and already-regulated deed-restricted affordable housing exclude rung 1's 'all rental units communitywide,' and its creation of a new mandatory statewide cap exceeds rung 3's 'maintain current tenant protections.'
